config.annotation_provenance: Agent approximate geometric hypotheses from visible window frame mesh hits in train image only. Back upper frame points ~[.112,3.809,2.524], [.591,6.328,2.501]; right upper/side/sill points ~[1.135,7.222,2.226], [1.600,7.495,2.505], [2.529,7.834,.646]. Right far endpoint is an unverified extrapolation outside image; aperture translation sensitivity required. No sunlight ground-truth mask or solar orientation calibration.
config.evaluation: Fit training brightness-proxy mask via Otsu on mesh-supported floor pixels; evaluate fixed direction on geometry-selected disjoint views. This is exploratory same-sequence multiview consistency, NOT independent semantic accuracy or cross-time relighting. Wrong direction +45deg, each window alone, and translated windows controls. No heldout-driven tuning.
